result.title: ST-GFM: Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting with Measured Perturbation Bounds and Masked Spectral Reconstruction
result.comment: 21 Pages, 11 Figures, 12 Tables, Supplementary Materials attached, Under Review
result.summary: Graph forecasters for sensor networks are trained in one regime and deployed in others, where sensor coupling and signal frequency content both change. We split this spectral shift into an operator channel and a frequency channel, each with a dimensionless measure. ST-GFM (Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting Model) filters every input step with Chebyshev and bidirectional diffusion filters on one learned, non-symmetric operator and alternates them with per-node temporal attention. For the operator channel we prove Frobenius-norm perturbation bounds for both graph branches, show that the Chebyshev bound is attained to first order, and compute its constant from the trained weights and the measured operator norm: 17.9 on METR-LA and 21.5 on PEMS-BAY. Under random edge dropout the trained layer moves by 2.0% to 3.1% of this bound. Masked Spectral Reconstruction (MSR), a self-supervised loss active in the first 40 epochs, matches the log power spectrum of the encoder output to that of the input. For small log-spectral residuals on unclamped bins it is proportional to an Itakura-Saito divergence to leading order. Removing it raises the 60-minute MAE by 0.30 on METR-LA, close to the 0.33 lost when all three self-supervised losses go. Under one shared evaluation pipeline, the 60-minute MAE of ST-GFM is 3.5% below a retrained STAEformer on METR-LA and 13.0% below it on PEMS-BAY. Its 60-minute MAE is 3.0980.017 on METR-LA (five seeds) and 1.5760.006 on PEMS-BAY (three seeds), the lowest PEMS-BAY MAE among twelve published baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向传感器网络的时间序列预测，提出 ST-GFM：在同一个学习到的非对称算子上交替使用 Chebyshev 与双向扩散滤波和逐节点时间注意力，并给出算子扰动下的 Frobenius 范数界，以及一个匹配编码器输出与输入对数功率谱的自监督重建损失（MSR）。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究内容为交通流量/传感器图预测，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态；谱重建损失与扰动界虽属训练监督与表示稳定性话题，但缺少与 VLM 推理、证据筛选或 latent 状态更新的具体联系，故排除。
